info.title: Student Information API
info.description: REST API for the student information system.

get.description: Purpose: return the enrollments of one student grouped by academic term, each with its course offering and grade. Auth: Bearer JWT. Access is granted to registrar, to the student that owns the record, and to faculty or advisors of an offering the student is enrolled in.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - another student record was requested or the role is not allowed.

404.description: Not found - no student matches the given id.

get.description: Purpose: browse academic terms with search, filters, sorting and pagination. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on code or name.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

422.description: Validation error - invalid query parameters.

post.description: Purpose: create an academic term. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

requestBody.description: Academic term payload. `code`, `name`, `term_type`, `academic_year`, `start_date`, `end_date` and `status` are required.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

409.description: Conflict - the term code already exists.

422.description: Validation error - duplicate code or invalid dates.

get.description: Purpose: read a single academic term. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no academic term matches the given id.

put.description: Purpose: replace an academic term; every required field must be supplied. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no academic term matches the given id.

409.description: Conflict - the term code is already used by another term.

422.description: Validation error - duplicate code or invalid dates.

delete.description: Purpose: delete an academic term and return `null` data. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar. A term that is still referenced by course offerings is rejected by the database.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no academic term matches the given id.

409.description: Conflict - course offerings still reference this academic term.

patch.description: Purpose: partially update an academic term, for example opening registration. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

requestBody.description: Any subset of the academic term fields, for example `{"status": "open"}`.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no academic term matches the given id.

422.description: Validation error - invalid value for a supplied field.

get.description: Purpose: browse courses with search, filters, sorting and pagination. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on course code or title.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

422.description: Validation error - invalid query parameters.

post.description: Purpose: create a course. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

409.description: Conflict - the course code already exists.

422.description: Validation error - duplicate code, unknown program or invalid value.

get.description: Purpose: read a single course with its program. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no course matches the given id.

put.description: Purpose: replace a course; every required field must be supplied. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no course matches the given id.

409.description: Conflict - the course code is already used by another course.

422.description: Validation error - duplicate code, unknown program or invalid value.

delete.description: Purpose: delete a course and return `null` data. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar. A course that is still referenced by course offerings is rejected by the database.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no course matches the given id.

409.description: Conflict - course offerings still reference this course.

patch.description: Purpose: partially update a course; only the supplied fields are validated and saved. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

requestBody.description: Any subset of the course fields, for example `{"title": "Updated Accounting"}`.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no course matches the given id.

422.description: Validation error - invalid value for a supplied field.

get.description: Purpose: browse the classes offered for an academic term. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar, faculty, instructor, advisor. A student account, and faculty or instructors of other offerings, receive 403; faculty and instructors only see their own offerings.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on the course code or title.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - student account or role not allowed to browse offerings.

422.description: Validation error - invalid query parameters.

post.description: Purpose: schedule a section of a course for an academic term. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

requestBody.description: Course offering payload. `course_id`, `academic_term_id`, `instructor_id`, `section`, `day_of_week`, `start_time`, `end_time`, `delivery_mode`, `capacity` and `status` are required.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

409.description: Conflict - the same course, term and section combination already exists.

422.description: Validation error - unknown course or term, instructor without a teaching role, or invalid schedule.

get.description: Purpose: read a single course offering with its course, term and instructor. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar, faculty, instructor, advisor; students receive 403 and instructors may only read their own offerings.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - student account or an instructor that is not assigned to this offering.

404.description: Not found - no course offering matches the given id.

put.description: Purpose: replace a course offering; every required field must be supplied. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no course offering matches the given id.

409.description: Conflict - the same course, term and section combination already exists.

422.description: Validation error - unknown course or term, instructor without a teaching role, or invalid schedule.

delete.description: Purpose: delete a course offering and return `null` data. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar. A course offering that still has enrollments is rejected by the database.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no course offering matches the given id.

409.description: Conflict - enrollments still reference this course offering.

patch.description: Purpose: partially update a course offering, for example closing it or moving the room. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

requestBody.description: Any subset of the course offering fields, for example `{"room": "CCS 305", "status": "closed"}`.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no course offering matches the given id.

422.description: Validation error - invalid value for a supplied field.

get.description: Purpose: browse enrollments; students only receive their own rows and faculty or instructors only the rows of their own offerings. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar, faculty, instructor, advisor, student.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - the authenticated role may not list enrollments.

422.description: Validation error - invalid query parameters.

post.description: Purpose: enroll a student in a course offering; `course_offerings.enrolled_count` is incremented when the status is `enrolled`. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

409.description: Conflict - "The student is already enrolled in this course offering." (duplicate enrollment).

422.description: Validation error - unknown student or course offering, or invalid dates.

get.description: Purpose: read a single enrollment with its student, course offering and grade. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar, faculty, instructor, advisor; students may only read their own enrollment and instructors only enrollments of their own offerings.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - the enrollment belongs to another student or to another instructor.

404.description: Not found - no enrollment matches the given id.

put.description: Purpose: replace an enrollment; every required field must be supplied. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no enrollment matches the given id.

409.description: Conflict - the student is already enrolled in the target course offering.

422.description: Validation error - unknown student or course offering, or invalid dates.

delete.description: Purpose: delete an enrollment and return `null` data; `enrolled_count` is decremented first when the enrollment was active. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no enrollment matches the given id.

409.description: Conflict - a grade still references this enrollment.

patch.description: Purpose: partially update an enrollment, for example dropping a course; the `enrolled_count` of the offering is adjusted when the status changes. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

requestBody.description: Any subset of the enrollment fields, for example `{"status": "dropped", "dropped_on": "2026-09-15"}`.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no enrollment matches the given id.

422.description: Validation error - invalid value for a supplied field.

get.summary: List the enrollments of one student
get.description: Purpose: read every enrollment of one student, newest first, as a non-paginated list. Auth: Bearer JWT. Access is granted to registrar, to the student that owns the record, and to faculty or advisors of an offering the student is enrolled in.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - "You are not authorized to view these enrollments." (URL tampering by a student or an unassigned instructor).

404.description: Not found - no student matches the given id.

get.summary: List the students of one course offering
get.description: Purpose: roster of the students enrolled in a course offering, ordered by enrollment date. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar, faculty, instructor, advisor; students receive 403 and instructors may only read their own offerings.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - "Students cannot view offering rosters." or an instructor that is not assigned to this offering.

404.description: Not found - no course offering matches the given id.

get.description: Purpose: browse grades; students only receive their own grades and faculty or instructors only grades of their own offerings. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar, faculty, instructor, advisor, student.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - the authenticated role may not list grades.

422.description: Validation error - invalid query parameters.

post.description: Purpose: record the grade of an enrollment. Only the instructor assigned to the enrollment offering may create it; `graded_by` is set from the token and `graded_at` defaults to now. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: faculty, instructor.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - "Only the instructor assigned to this offering may manage its grades." or the role is not allowed.

409.description: Conflict - the enrollment already has a grade.

422.description: Validation error - unknown enrollment or a grade outside the 0-100 / 0-4 range.

get.description: Purpose: read a single grade with its enrollment, student, course offering and grading user. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar, faculty, instructor, advisor; students may only read their own grades and instructors only grades of their own offerings.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - the grade belongs to another student or to an offering of another instructor.

404.description: Not found - no grade matches the given id.

put.description: Purpose: replace a grade; every required field must be supplied. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: faculty, instructor. Only the instructor assigned to the offering may update its grades.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - "Only the instructor assigned to this offering may manage its grades." or the role is not allowed.

404.description: Not found - no grade matches the given id.

409.description: Conflict - the target enrollment already has a grade.

422.description: Validation error - unknown enrollment or a grade outside the 0-100 / 0-4 range.

patch.description: Purpose: partially update a grade, for example revising the numeric grade. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: faculty, instructor. Only the instructor assigned to the offering may update its grades.

requestBody.description: Any subset of the grade fields, for example `{"numeric_grade": 90, "status": "revised"}`.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - "Only the instructor assigned to this offering may manage its grades." or the role is not allowed.

404.description: Not found - no grade matches the given id.

422.description: Validation error - invalid value for a supplied field.

get.summary: List the grades of one student
get.description: Purpose: read every grade of one student as a non-paginated list, with the enrollment, course offering and grading user loaded. Auth: Bearer JWT. Access is granted to registrar, to the student that owns the record, and to faculty or advisors of an offering the student is enrolled in.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - "You are not authorized to view these grades." (URL tampering by a student or an unassigned instructor).

404.description: Not found - no student matches the given id.

get.description: Purpose: browse academic programs with search, filters, sorting and pagination. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on code, name or department.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

422.description: Validation error - invalid query parameters.

post.description: Purpose: create an academic program. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

409.description: Conflict - the program code already exists.

422.description: Validation error - duplicate code or invalid value.

get.description: Purpose: read a single program. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no program matches the given id.

put.description: Purpose: replace a program; every required field must be supplied. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no program matches the given id.

409.description: Conflict - the program code is already used by another program.

422.description: Validation error - duplicate code or invalid value.

delete.description: Purpose: delete a program and return `null` data. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar. A program that is still referenced by students or courses is rejected by the database.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no program matches the given id.

409.description: Conflict - students or courses still reference this program.

patch.description: Purpose: partially update a program; only the supplied fields are validated and saved. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar.

requestBody.description: Any subset of the program fields, for example `{"name": "Computer Science"}`.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

404.description: Not found - no program matches the given id.

409.description: Conflict - the program code is already used by another program.

422.description: Validation error - invalid value for a supplied field.

get.description: Purpose: browse student profiles with search, filters, sorting and pagination. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar (a student account receives 403).

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on first name, last name or student number.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with `-` for descending order.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - the authenticated role may not list student records.

422.description: Validation error - invalid query parameters.

post.description: Purpose: create a student profile linked to an existing user account. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar (student accounts receive 403).

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - the authenticated role may not create students.

409.description: Conflict - the user account or student number already has a student profile.

422.description: Validation error - unique student number, invalid email or unknown foreign keys.

get.description: Purpose: read a single student profile with its program. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar, and students for their own record only.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - a student account requested another student id.

404.description: Not found - no student matches the given id.

put.description: Purpose: replace a student profile; every required field must be supplied. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar (student accounts receive 403).

requestBody.description: Full student payload; the same required fields as `POST /api/v1/students` apply.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - the authenticated role may not update students.

404.description: Not found - no student matches the given id.

409.description: Conflict - the student number or user account is already taken.

422.description: Validation error - required field missing or invalid value.

delete.description: Purpose: deactivate a student profile; the record is kept and returned with `status: "inactive"`. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar (student accounts receive 403).

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - the authenticated role may not deactivate students.

404.description: Not found - no student matches the given id.

patch.description: Purpose: partially update a student profile; only the supplied fields are validated and saved. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: registrar (student accounts receive 403).

requestBody.description: Any subset of the student fields, for example `{"first_name": "Janet"}`.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - the authenticated role may not update students.

404.description: Not found - no student matches the given id.

409.description: Conflict - the student number or user account is already taken.

422.description: Validation error - invalid value for a supplied field.

get.description: Purpose: directory of active user accounts (id, name, email, role, status) ordered by last name; used to pick instructors and other actors. Auth: Bearer JWT. Roles: admin, registrar.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

403.description: Forbidden - role is not admin or registrar.

post.description: Purpose: exchange credentials for a JWT. Auth: none - this is the only public endpoint.

requestBody.description: Credentials of an active user account. `email` and `password` are required.

200.description: Authenticated - returns the JWT and its lifetime.

401.description: Invalid credentials - "Invalid credentials."

422.description: Validation error - email or password missing.

get.description: Purpose: return the authenticated user record (no `data` wrapper). Auth: Bearer JWT, any role.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

post.description: Purpose: revoke the presented token so it can no longer be used. No request body is required. Auth: Bearer JWT, any role.

401.description: Unauthenticated - missing, malformed or expired JWT.

UserResource.description: User account object. Returned by `GET /api/v1/users` (subset) and embedded as the `instructor` or `graded_by` relation.

id.description: Response payload schemas for the API resources returned inside `data`.

name.example: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology

CourseResource.description: Course object returned in `data`. The `program` relation is included by `GET /api/v1/courses/{course}`.

description.example: Introduction to algorithms and problem solving.

program.description: Only present when the request eager loads the program.

StudentResource.description: Student profile object returned in `data`. The `program` relation is present on every student endpoint response.

cumulative_gpa.description: Decimal cast, therefore serialized as a string.

CourseOfferingResource.description: Course offering object returned in `data`. Relation keys are `course`, `academic_term` and `instructor`; the index endpoint returns the raw model with the same relation keys.

EnrollmentResource.description: Enrollment object returned in `data`. Relation keys are `student`, `course_offering` (with `course` and `academic_term`) and `grade`.

GradeResource.description: Grade object returned in `data`. `graded_by` holds the grading user id until the `gradedBy` relation is loaded, in which case it contains the user object.

numeric_grade.description: Decimal cast, therefore serialized as a string.

grade_points.description: Decimal cast, therefore serialized as a string.

graded_by.description: User id, or the loaded grading user object.

AcademicRecordResource.description: Academic record returned by `GET /api/v1/students/{student}/academic-record`: a student summary plus enrollments grouped by academic term.

student.description: Student summary (subset of the student fields).

terms.description: One entry per academic term that has enrollments.

ApiError.description: Error envelope returned for 401 (unauthenticated), 403 (forbidden), 404 (not found) and 409 (conflict) responses. The `success` key is omitted for framework level 401/404 responses, where Laravel only renders `message`.

success.description: Shared error envelopes and typed success envelopes referenced by the endpoint annotations.

message.example: You are not authorized to perform this action.

student_id: The selected student id is invalid.

example.message: You are not authorized to perform this action.

ValidationError.description: Envelope returned for every 422 validation failure. `errors` is keyed by request field name.

per_page: The per page field must not be greater than 100.

student_id: The selected student id is invalid.

SuccessResponse.description: Generic success envelope for endpoints that return `null` data (deletes and the course offering delete). `message` is one of "Program deleted successfully.", "Course deleted successfully.", "Academic term deleted successfully.", "Course offering deleted successfully." or "Enrollment deleted successfully.".

StudentItemResponse.description: Single student payload returned by the student create, read, update and deactivate endpoints.

message.description: One of "Student created successfully.", "Student retrieved successfully.", "Student updated successfully." or "Student deactivated successfully.".

program.name: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology

ProgramItemResponse.description: Single program payload returned by the program create, read, update and delete endpoints.

message.description: One of "Program created successfully.", "Program retrieved successfully.", "Program updated successfully." or "Program deleted successfully.".

data.name: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology

CourseItemResponse.description: Single course payload returned by the course create, read, update and delete endpoints. `GET /api/v1/courses/{course}` also includes the `program` relation.

message.description: One of "Course created successfully.", "Course retrieved successfully.", "Course updated successfully." or "Course deleted successfully.".

data.title: Programming Fundamentals
data.description: Introduction to algorithms and problem solving.

program.name: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology

AcademicTermItemResponse.description: Single academic term payload returned by the academic term create, read, update and delete endpoints.

message.description: One of "Academic term created successfully.", "Academic term retrieved successfully.", "Academic term updated successfully." or "Academic term deleted successfully.".

CourseOfferingItemResponse.description: Single course offering payload returned by the create, read and update endpoints. The `course`, `academic_term` and `instructor` relations are loaded by the create, show and update operations.

message.description: One of "Course offering created successfully.", "Course offering retrieved successfully." or "Course offering updated successfully.".

EnrollmentItemResponse.description: Single enrollment payload returned by the enrollment create, read and update endpoints. Relations `student`, `course_offering` and `grade` are loaded.

message.description: One of "Enrollment created successfully.", "Enrollment retrieved successfully." or "Enrollment updated successfully.".

GradeItemResponse.description: Single grade payload returned by the grade create, read and update endpoints. Relations `enrollment` (with `student` and `course_offering`) and `graded_by` are loaded.

message.description: One of "Grade created successfully.", "Grade retrieved successfully." or "Grade updated successfully.".

AcademicRecordResponse.description: Payload returned by `GET /api/v1/students/{student}/academic-record`: enrollments grouped by academic term.

UserListResponse.description: Payload for `GET /api/v1/users`: active user accounts ordered by last name.

StudentEnrollmentListResponse.description: Payload for `GET /api/v1/students/{student}/enrollments`: every enrollment of one student, newest first, with `student`, `course_offering` (plus `course` and `academic_term`) and `grade` loaded. Not paginated.

CourseOfferingStudentListResponse.description: Payload for `GET /api/v1/course-offerings/{course_offering}/students`: the roster of one course offering, ordered by enrollment date. Not paginated.

StudentGradeListResponse.description: Payload for `GET /api/v1/students/{student}/grades`: every grade of one student with `enrollment` (plus `student` and `course_offering`) and `graded_by` loaded. Not paginated.

StudentIndexResponse.description: Payload for `GET /api/v1/students`. Unlike the other index endpoints, `data` is a flat array and the pagination values live in the top-level `meta` object.

program.name: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology

meta.description: Pagination metadata for the filtered result set.

ProgramCollectionResponse.description: Payload for `GET /api/v1/programs`: a length-aware paginator in `data`, so the rows are in `data.data`.

data.name: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology

CourseCollectionResponse.description: Payload for `GET /api/v1/courses`: a length-aware paginator in `data`, so the rows are in `data.data`.

AcademicTermCollectionResponse.description: Payload for `GET /api/v1/academic-terms`: a length-aware paginator in `data`, so the rows are in `data.data`.

CourseOfferingCollectionResponse.description: Payload for `GET /api/v1/course-offerings`: a length-aware paginator in `data`, so the rows are in `data.data`. Faculty and instructors only receive their own offerings.

EnrollmentCollectionResponse.description: Payload for `GET /api/v1/enrollments`: a length-aware paginator in `data`, so the rows are in `data.data`. Students only receive their own rows and faculty or instructors only rows of their own offerings.

GradeCollectionResponse.description: Payload for `GET /api/v1/grades`: a length-aware paginator in `data`, so the rows are in `data.data`. Students only receive their own grades and faculty or instructors only grades of their own offerings.
